facts.fact: Under NFSA the eldest woman of the household aged 18 years or above is the head of the household for issuing ration cards
facts.quote: the eldest woman of the household of age 18 years or above is mandated to be the head of the household for the purpose of issuing of ration cards under the Act.

summary: Confirmed on the nfsa.gov.in NFSA Act page: eldest woman aged 18+ is head of household for ration cards.
